actor: model-serving security platform engineer at a hyperscaler cloud provider
job: Hardening the managed-inference upload and serving path so safe artifact handling becomes a platform default rather than an opt-in convenience.
outcome: A hyperscaler ships safe-serialization defaults or caller-ownership checks on model uploads, documented in a model-serving changelog or security bulletin.
motivation: A published cross-tenant RCE makes the multi-tenant deserialization gap a reputational and compliance liability the platform must close before peers and auditors weaponize it.

task.who: the managed-inference platform security and serving-runtime engineering team
task.what: enforce caller bucket-ownership checks and non-executable artifact loading
task.where: the model upload, staging-bucket, and serving-container deserialization path
task.why: close the cross-tenant deserialization break before peers and auditors exploit it
task.how: UUID staging buckets, ownership verification, and safetensors-class loading defaults

job: Advancing non-executable serialization formats and signed/attested model-provenance tooling so serving platforms can adopt them as a trustworthy default substrate.
outcome: Hardened safetensors-class formats and artifact-signing/attestation tooling reach the maturity a managed platform can mandate by default for model artifacts.
motivation: Becoming the de-facto safe artifact substrate that platforms default to cements the format's adoption and displaces pickle as the multi-tenant loading standard.

task.who: the open-source serialization-format and model-signing tooling maintainer team
task.what: harden non-executable formats and signed artifact-provenance verification
task.where: the format libraries and model-artifact signing and attestation toolchain
task.why: give serving platforms a mature safe substrate to mandate by default
task.how: safetensors-class formats plus signed and attested provenance verification

actor: standards or security-guidance body author tracking ML supply-chain and inference risk
job: Codifying safe model-artifact handling at the multi-tenant boundary into citable guidance, using the Vertex AI cross-tenant break as the reference incident.
outcome: A standards or guidance body publishes language prescribing non-executable serialization, signed provenance, and caller-ownership checks for managed model serving.
motivation: A concrete cross-tenant break with an already-shipped remediation path gives the body a citable incident to codify the pattern before vendor approaches fragment.

task.who: the ML supply-chain security working group or guidance-authoring team
task.what: publish guidance prescribing safe artifact handling for managed serving
task.where: standards documents, security advisories, or framework guidance output
task.why: codify the pattern from a citable incident before vendor approaches fragment
task.how: reference mapping to the Pickle-in-the-Middle incident and Google's remediation
